posts.body: I'm using a plugin by Caethyril that takes away the party command in battle (Fight/Escape). I made a skill to escape with my party members, but it isn't working the way I want it. The problem is that when I use the skill and escape battle, the battle music continues outside of battle. I've tried everything in the skill setup and common events. I've also searched for plugins, but I can't get it to work.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
show us your setup, as ending the battle should return to the map BGM.
if this isn't the case by your skill usage, it may how the plugin works.
either double check the plugin description, or ask the author of the plugin.
did you test it with only that plugin or do you use more plugins?
